description: This file defines and implements the `Transformation` class and related functions used for affine transformations on points within the Leaflet library. It includes methods for transforming points and their inverses, and factory functions for creating transformation instances.

classes.name: Transformation
classes.description: Represents an affine transformation that can transform and untransform points using coefficients.

methods.name: Transformation
methods.description: Constructs a new Transformation instance using provided coefficients or an array of coefficients.

methods.name: transform(point, scale)
methods.description: Transforms a point using the affine transformation, optionally scaled.

methods.name: _transform(point, scale)
methods.description: Internal method that performs the actual transformation, used by 'transform'.

methods.name: untransform(point, scale)
methods.description: Reverses the transformation on a point, optionally scaled.

methods.name: toTransformation(a, b, c, d)
methods.description: Factory function that creates a new Transformation object from coefficients.
